The '''5k c3 carbon/halon extinguisher system''' was a type of [[Fire extinguisher/Legends|fire extinguisher]] installed in a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter's]] [[Power Surge Vent]]. It was designed to shut the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter's]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]] down in an emergency.<ref name="SWS" />
